scene.ofreeRecent: the paved square before a city gate tower — carries her keepsake low at her side; a quiet rooftop swimming pool with tiled steps and distant city roofs — she steps out of the pool and squeezes water from a broad cotton towel at her waist; a sunny modern bakery terrace beside a small open service hatch — wearing a playful pastry-chef costume she raises a tray of fresh pastries to the shelf; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a retro American diner — seated on a chair; a modern bowling alley under cool bright overhead lights — after releasing a bowling ball she watches its path with an amused little smile; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — twists the cap off a water bottle; a quiet spa lounge of robes — standing; a glass greenhouse full of plants with a wooden potting bench — kneeling on the ground; a castle courtyard rose garden around a stone fountain — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her left side; a small repair kiosk with a cluttered workbench — carries a camera by its grip at her side; the top of a restored ancient city wall — carries a small red paper lantern by its cord
